content: Yesu Akanguisa Yala ua Vimbembesi Viavipi
Yesu na vandongisi vendi vaile musinia lia cisali, ku lifuti lia Ngelasa.
Kaha omo uahumine mu vuato, ualiuanene na yala ha vihilo uje uakele na cimbembesi cacipi,
uakele nakukala ha vihilo, kaha na muntu uahi uasele kumukuta, cipue na malienge,
omuo lualuingi vakele nakumukuta na tukunju na malienge, vuno honi uakele nakuvatuzola malienge na kupokozola tukunju mu vimbazuvuila, kaha naumo uahi uakele na nzili ya ku muononuesa.
Vutsiki na mutania uakele ha vihilo na ha minkinda oku alila, nakulivetuesa ikeye vavenia na mavue.
Kaha omo uamuene Yesu kulahako, uashatukilile kuli ikeye na kumulemesa,
kaha ualilile na lizi liakutambeka nguendi, “Vika utonda kuli yange, Yesu, Muna Njambi ua Helu lia Vioshe? Njilomba mu lizina lia Njambi, keti unjiyandese.”
Omuo uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Huma muli ou yala, yove cimbembesi cacipi!”
Kaha Yesu ua muihuile nguendi, “Yove iya?” Kaha uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Yange civunga, omuo tuvavengi.”
Kaha vamulombele cikuma linga keti avasheke mu lifuti lije.
Nankuma kuakele vutanga vua vangulu vakele na kulia kuje ku munkinda,
kaha vije vimbembesi viavipi via mulombele nguavio, “Tushekele kuje ku vutanga vua vangulu, linga tukakovele muli vakevo.”

Kaha uavatavesele. Kaha vije vimbembesi viavipi viamuhumine, kaha viakovelele mu vutanga vua vangulu, nankuma vangulu voshe vapuile makulukazi avali, kaha vashatukile nakukakovela mu cisali muje muvakanongelele.
Vaje tuniungi vateuele, kaha vakalekele vije vivamuene mu nganda na mu cifuti. Kaha vantu vezile nakumona vije vialingikile.

Kaha vezile kuli Yesu, kaha vamuene uje yala uakele na vimbembesi viavipi natumama kuje, nazala vuino na mana acili anahiluka muli ikeye, yala uje uakele na vimbembesi viavingi viavipi, kaha vateuele.
Kaha vaje vacimuene vahandekele vije vialingiuile kuli uje yala uakele na vimbembesi viavipi naku vutanga vua vangulu.
Kaha vaputukile kulambelela Yesu linga ahume mu cihela cavo.
Kaha omo uatondele ku kovela mu vuato, uje yala uakele na mahamba ua lombele linga akale nendi.
Vuno honi ua vianene, kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Ya kuimbo kuli vavusamba vove, ukavalekese via nakulingila Muene, nomu muanakela nacikeketima hali yove.”
Kaha uaile na kuputuka kuambulula mu Ndikapolisi (kulumbununa vinganda likumi) viuma vije viamulingilile Yesu. Kaha vantu voshe valikomokelele.
Muna Njailosi uamumbanda na Mpuevo uje uakuatele ku kazaku ka Yesu
Kaha omo Yesu uajavukile naua mu vuato kuya musinia ya cisali, civunga cakama ca vantu cakele nendi, kaha uakele kumukulo ya cisali.
Kaha umo mukuluntu uamu njivo ya malombelo, lizina liendi ikeye Njailosi, omo uamuene Yesu uauililile ku viliato viendi,
Ua mulambelele nguendi, “Munange ua mpuevo alinakutonda kutsa. Ija ukamusaleke mavoko ove, linga akanguke na kuyoya.”
Kaha uaile nendi. Civunga cakama ca mukavele oku vamutseka.
Kaha kuakele mpuevo uakele na kuhita maninga ha miaka likumi naivali,
uje uayandele cikuma ku vimbanda, uapihisile viuma vioshe viakele navio, vuno honi kakangukile, vuno honi mushongo uendi uatualeleho kuya kuintsi cikuma.
Kaha omo uovuile lutsimo lua Yesu, uamukavele munima yendi mu civunga na kumukuata ku kazaku kendi.
Omuo uahandekele nguendi, “Nga njikakuata cipue lika ku kazaku kendi kaha njikakanguka.”
Kaha hajevene aje maninga emanene, kaha uovuile mu muvila uendi nguendi nakanguka ku mushongo uendi.
Kaha Yesu uovuile nzili yahumine mu muli ikeye, kaha hajevene uatengulukilile ku civunga, nakuhandekele nguendi, “Iya nakuata ku kazaku kange?”
Kaha vandongisi vendi vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Unamono civunga cili nakukutseka vuno honi uhandeka nguove, Iya nanjikuata?”
Kaha uatalele talele linga amone uje ualingile eci.
Vuno honi uje mpuevo ha kutantekeya cije calingiuile kuli ikeye, uezile kuli Yesu na liova oku alina kujaja nakuuila ku viliato viendi, na kumulekesa vusunga vuoshe.
Kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Munange ua mpuevo, lutsilielo luove luakukanguisa, ya mu ciyulo kaha kanguka ku mushongo uove.”
Omo te acili nakuhandeka kuezile vantu kuhuma ku njivo ya mu kakuyula vamo vahandekele nguavo, “Munove ua mpuevo natsi. Vika uyandesela Mulongisi naua?”
Vuno honi kahakeleko mangana kuli vije viva handekele, Yesu uahandekele kuli muka kuyula ua mu njivo ya malombelo nguendi, “Keti uteue, tsiliela lika.”
Katavesele muntu uoshe kumukava kuvanga lika Petulu na Tiango na Iuano munaina ya Tiango.
Omo vahetele ku njivo ya muka kuyula ua njivo ya malombelo, uamuene vitanga, na vantu valila nakukangoka cikuma.
Kaha omo uakovelele, uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vika mukangokela na kulila? Kanike katsile vuno honi nakosa tulo.”
Kaha vamujolele. Kaha uavatuhuisile voshe hambanza, kaha uambatele vaishe ya muana na vanaye navaje vakele navo, kaha vaile muje muakele uje kanike.
Uamukuatele ku livoko nakuhandeka kuli ikeye nguendi, “Talita kumi.” Kulumbununa, “Kanike ka mpuevo, njihandeka kuli yove nguange hinduka.”
Hajevene uje kanike ka mpuevo uahindukile na kuenda (uakele na miaka likumi na ivali), kaha voshe valikomokelele.
Kaha ua vasinkikile cikuma nguendi, keti kukale cipue umo napande kutantekeya eci, kaha uavalekele vamuhane viakulia alie.
